text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After spending some time out with Winning 
Ticket, we returned to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: We're heeere! That was so fun, Trainer!!
choice_data_list:
Were you able to catch your breath and 
unwind?
Did you manage to unwind a bit?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Totally refreshed, refreshed! 
Feeling completely energized!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"You'll forget all about little worries 
like that! Well, even without refreshing 
myself, I'd forget anyway!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh? The one standing by the 
school gate is—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Uuu~...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, Spe-chan? Something on 
your mind?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ticket-zo-san.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"I heard the academic test results were 
posted, so I went to take a look, but..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I brilliantly earned myself supplementary 
lessons, waaaahhh~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, you mean that academic test from the 
other day...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~... I need to ask Suzuka-san to 
tutor me again...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I understand!! I totally understand, 
Spe-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Just when I thought I was finally free 
from studying for exams, supplementary 
lessons out of nowhere!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOO~N!! That's gotta be so rough~~! 
Poor Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I'll sort out your worries in a 
flash!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Solved...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Come on, follow me! You too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? You want me to come along, but 
where to?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Alright, we're here! Spe-chan, the river!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's definitely a river...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You know, rivers get this big because all 
the tiny trickles of water from the 
mountains gather together!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Joining forces together is so amazing, 
isn't it?! Woooow! I'm... so... MOVED!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Next up!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait... what?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Here you go, Spe-chan, the park!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: The park... Yes, let's.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! The little Umamusume kids are 
having a footrace!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Maybe they're dreaming of the Derby too! 
Woooaaah! Go for it--!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Alright, next!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan, the shrine! The view from the 
shrine, you see—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Um, the shrine is fine and all, but 
just what in the world is this...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean? It's sheer emotion! Pure 
emotion!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Just seeing a little bit of the scenery 
just now was already super moving, wasn't 
it?"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Remedial classes are certainly tough and 
disappointing, and they might get you 
down, but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
When you look forward, there's so much to 
be moved by! Incredible moments that blow 
all those little worries right away!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Blow away... all my worries...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So let's be deeply moved, blow away our 
worries, and move forward!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Look, compared to the view from up here, 
your current worries are teeny-tiny!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So many buildings, so many people... 
Somehow, my own worries are starting to 
feel so small!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, compared to this city scenery, 
supplementary lessons are like tiny potato 
sprouts!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm so glad to see you're feeling 
better~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding♪)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? A message from a friend.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, NO WAYYY~~!? I have to take 
remedial classes too~~!?"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What am I gonna doooo?! There won't be any 
time left for training or playing around 
anymore! *waaaah!*
choice_data_list:
It's nothing to worry too much about. Hang 
in there!

It's nothing to worry too much about. Good 
luck!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What am I gonna doooo?! There won't be any 
time left for training or playing around 
anymore! *waaaah!*
choice_data_list:
It's nothing to worry too much about. Hang 
in there!

It's nothing to worry too much about. Good 
luck!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's so meaaan~~! It's a really big deal 
to meee~~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What?! Even though you said it was tiny?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"It's alright, remedial classes are just a 
minor setback! Let's overcome them 
together!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOO~N! What an incredibly strong girl~! 
Let's do our best! Let's work hard 
togetheeeer~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ending up comforted by the very person she 
tried to comfort, Winning Ticket steeled 
herself for remedial classes.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaaahhhhh! Thank youuuu~! Let me get some 
restttt~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'll come along with you, so let's 
travel around and search for something 
moving!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Spe-chaaan! What kind of angel are youuu?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right, dashing at full throttle 
straight toward sheer emotional bliss!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After walking around here and there once 
more, Winning Ticket managed to calm 
herself down.
